alexa_skill.title: Brainstorm › Alexa
alexa_skill.description:
**Native** works without setup: say "Alexa, note ...". Alexa may report an error first, then Brainstorm saves the idea.

**Skill** gives one clean answer: say "Alexa, tell Brainstorm note ...". It needs your own free Alexa skill and a Home Assistant reachable from the internet.

**Both** accepts both ways.

data_description.voice_mode: Native uses the Alexa Media sentence without a skill. Skill and Both use your own Alexa skill.

ai.title: Brainstorm › AI
ai.description:
Brainstorm uses an AI task entity of Home Assistant, such as Google Gemini, OpenAI or Ollama. Without one, all of this stays off.

With just the entity chosen, ✨ on a note of the mind map suggests subtasks. The two switches below are extra jobs for the AI.

data.ai_enabled: Shorten the briefing and review with AI

data_description.ai_entity: When set, ✨ on a note of the mind map suggests subtasks. Only this note, its category and its subtasks are sent, and only when you press the button.
data_description.ai_text_cleanup: Each spoken entry is stored first and improved a few seconds later. The result is dropped if it adds words or changes a negation. The text goes to the provider of the chosen AI.
data_description.ai_enabled: The morning briefing and weekly review of the reminders are shortened. Your entries go to the provider of the chosen AI for this.
data_description.go_back: Returns to the previous page without saving this form.

todo_sync.title: Brainstorm › Link To-do Lists
todo_sync.description:
Link a category to a to-do list of another integration, such as Bring!, Google Tasks, Todoist or a local to-do list. Both stay in step:

• Active notes are added to the list, and items added there become notes.
• Renaming or ticking off on one side does the same on the other.
• Deleting a note removes its item. An item removed from the list ticks off its note.
• Due times go to the list if it supports them.

With privacy on, only notes shared with everyone are synced, as everyone with access to the other list sees them. Clearing a field unlinks the list and leaves its items alone.

data_description.go_back: Returns to the previous page without saving this form.

data_description.bring_done_days: Ticked off items leave the completed view of Brainstorm after this many days; they stay in Bring for buying again. 0 keeps them.

privacy.title: Brainstorm › Privacy & Users
privacy.description:
Off: everyone sees all ideas, as before. On: every idea belongs to its creator, and only they and the people it is shared with can see it in the cards. Share entries by long-pressing them on the card.

Note: To-do lists only show ideas shared with everyone, because everyone can read them. Admins can always read all data.

data_description.privacy_enabled: Each person then sees only their own entries and what is shared with them.

skill_no_public_url.title: The Alexa skill cannot reach Home Assistant
skill_no_public_url.description:
Brainstorm Hub uses your own Alexa skill, but Home Assistant has no public HTTPS address. Alexa cannot deliver any request, so nothing said to the skill is saved.

Set an external HTTPS address under **Settings > System > Network** or use Home Assistant Cloud. Then open **Brainstorm Hub > Configure > Alexa voice input & skill** and copy the skill code into the Alexa developer console again. Or switch the voice input back to **Native**.

missing_echos.title: Chosen Echos no longer exist
missing_echos.description:
These Echos are chosen in Brainstorm Hub but no longer exist in Home Assistant: {echos}

Ideas from them are let through, and reminders are not spoken there. Choose your Echos again under **Brainstorm Hub > Configure**, in the Echo choice and in the reminder settings.
